metrics: harmful recommendation rate (decisions where P4 deviated from d(s) and the one-step counterfactual was worse than d(s))
recommendation coverage (share of decisions where P4 deviates from d(s))
primary_endpoint: Episode-level paired lexicographic comparison P4 vs P2 (label-free default): share of episodes strictly worse (safety) with share strictly better reported alongside.
caveat: Training labels assume label-free continuation (one-step counterfactual, Q^label-free). Applying the selector at every decision is a policy-improvement step whose lexicographic, non-additive objective is not covered by the policy-improvement theorem, so closed-loop gains must be measured, not assumed.
